d:
爱莎贝儿-163CM-L 粉肤 AHRC009 爱原空美 Aihara Kumi-专属星光
他忽然从背后环住我，气息擦过耳尖：“镜子都要嫉妒你了。”
手指轻轻整理我裙摆，“别怕，待会全场灯光，只追着我眼里这位仙女跑。”
套上高跟鞋时，他单膝蹲着仰头看我：“完了，我舍不得放你出场了。”
他把无线麦别在我腰间，声音突然放软：“记不记得你说，只做我一个人的星星？今晚特许你，照亮全世界。”
身型：163CM-L 粉肤

Elsa Babe-163CM-L Pink AHRC009 Aihara Kumi-Exclusive Starlight
He suddenly wrapped his arms around me from behind, his breath brushing against my ear: "Even the mirrors are jealous of you."
His fingers gently adjusted my skirt. "Don't be afraid, all the lights will be focused on this fairy in my eyes."
As I slipped on my heels, he knelt on one knee, looking up at me: "Oh no, I can't bear to let you go on stage."
He clipped the wireless microphone to my waist, his voice suddenly softening: "Do you remember you said you'd be my star alone? Tonight, you're granted the privilege of lighting up the whole world."
Body type: 163CM-L with Pink skin tone.
